mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in one month signals a tightening labor market, which is typically associated with economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for two consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy slows.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy to combat inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL is rising, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increasing nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which is typically associated with economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals robust economic growth, which is a strong indicator of positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
